producer_report.summary: Added docs/design/direct-main-merge-tree-landing.md, a design note for throughput review 20261111-055051-tjym. It covers the bottleneck, the mechanism (fetch host main, then Git::merge_tree with base = the job's recorded base, then commit_tree, then push), why it removes the carried-over commits, existing code, how it differs from the earlier notes, alternatives, conflict handling, migration and rollback, the 5.0-minute prediction, how the next review measures it, and the citation requirement. I also added a CHANGELOG.md entry and roadmap step 3b under RM-0. Only docs changed. The note states that the figures come from the review text, because THROUGHPUT.md is not in the working copy. It also notes that the stage medians do not sum to 2990.6.
